name: fantastical-logic-grid-app
description: The Fantastical Logic Grid: browser (PWA) and desktop app.

scripts.serve: npm run build && node scripts/serve.mjs dist/web 8080
scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/e2e.cjs && node scripts/e2e-voices.cjs && node scripts/e2e-topics.cjs
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build && tauri dev --config desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && cd desktop && tauri build
scripts.desktop:build:win-from-linux: npm run build && cd desktop && tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu
scripts.test:accounts: npm --prefix server install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build && node scripts/e2e-accounts.cjs
scripts.test:server: npm --prefix server install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix server test
